messages:
Alex (Sales): Heads up — FinTechCo wants HSM-backed customer keys, daily rotation, and an escrow option. They also asked if per-deployment keys are possible and what the pricing delta looks like. Need a POC plan and checklist to send today.

Miguel (Solutions Eng): We can do BYOK with HSM-backed CMKs. Recommend Dedicated or Private deployment for the POC (network isolation + KMS peering). Important: runtime uses envelope encryption (we never call KMS per token). We unwrap/derive DEKs at startup and cache them; rotations are rewrap operations. Short rotation windows (<1h) are risky because we'd need more frequent rewraps and rolling restarts. Suggest testing with 24h and a forced-rotate flow.

Priya (Security): Quick notes for the questionnaire: 1) We don't persist plaintext CMKs outside customer HSM/KMS. 2) We support HSM attestation and can deliver attestation reports during onboarding. 3) Audit logs can be forwarded to customer's SIEM (CloudTrail/Stackdriver). Need confirmation from customer on which SIEM and retention. Also: escrow requests require legal signoff — raise with legal. :lock:

Alex (Sales): Jordan — rough pricing delta? Customer asks to budget.

Jordan (Pricing): Ballpark for HSM-backed CMK add-on: +30-50% on top of BYOK base (this includes HSM license/attestation & additional engineering onboarding). If they choose Dedicated with reserved commits, further discounts apply but baseline uplift still applies. I'll confirm exact numbers with finance but this is safe for initial budget.

Miguel (Solutions Eng): POC plan (high level):
1) Customer provisions HSM/KMS and grants a service account + key policy (we provide key URI)
2) Network steps: VPC peering/whitelist + test connectivity
3) Onboard attestation & run key handshake
4) Run test workload + simulate rotation (forced) and failover
5) Validate audit logs and SIEM forwarding

Sample config snippet we give customers for key binding:
```
key_binding: "kms://projects/fintechco/locations/global/keyRings/llm-keys/cryptoKeys/inference-cmk"
rekey_policy: { "rotation_window": "24h", "grace_period": "10m" }
```

Also note: to keep latency low we use prefix/KV caching of DEKs in the runtime; that means a rotation triggers background rewraps, not per-request KMS calls. If they insist on per-request DEK generation for extra isolation, expect higher latency and extra cost.

Sam (FinTechCo): Good summary. Two asks: 1) Can you provide an emergency revoke runbook (we need an SLA for key availability during rotation)? 2) We require assurance that no plaintext key material leaves our HSM.

Priya (Security): Confirmed: plaintext CMKs never leave the customer's HSM/KMS. DEKs are generated by runtime and immediately encrypted with the CMK (envelope encryption). We'll add an explicit clause for the security questionnaire and include the emergency revoke runbook steps (revoke KMS key -> trigger rewrap -> failover to fallback model). I can draft text for the questionnaire (SOC2/high level + FIPS attestation note).

Miguel (Solutions Eng): Emergency revoke runbook (summary):
- Step 0: Customer notifies Redwood support channel + opens incident
- Step 1: Customer rotates/revokes CMK in their KMS (we provide guidance)
- Step 2: Redwood runtime detects rotation via KMS event or scheduled poll, marks affected caches stale
- Step 3: Rolling rewraps + restart of affected nodes (can be automated for Dedicated)
- Step 4: Validate model responses and audit logs forwarded

I'll add a short test we can run in the POC to simulate revoke and validate zero-plaintext. Example test curl to trigger rotation check:
```bash
curl -X POST https://prow.redwood.example/poc/trigger-rotation-check -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```

Jordan (Pricing): For the quote I'll include: HSM add-on line, one-time onboarding fee (attestation + runbook), and an hourly ops estimate for rotation drills.

Alex (Sales): Great. @Priya @Miguel — can you draft the presales snippets (security answers + POC checklist) today? I'll share with customer tomorrow AM. Sam, appreciate the quick confirmation — we'll get the runbook and a tight POC timeline (target: 3 weeks from kickoff) and a preliminary price range. :white_check_mark:

Priya (Security): On it, I'll post draft answers in this thread before EOD.

Miguel (Solutions Eng): I'll spin up a one-off POC playbook and include the test commands + expected logs.

Sam (FinTechCo): Thanks all. Looking forward to the runbook and numbers.
